## The Pitching Matchup By The Numbers

Nick Martinez takes the ball for Tampa Bay against Carlos Rodón for the Yankees. At 52% confidence, this is another tight projection - we're looking at marginal edges here, not blowout predictions. The model sees something in this matchup that tilts slightly toward the Rays, even on the road in the Bronx.

These sub-55% picks require volume to show profitability. One game means nothing. A hundred games at 52% win rate? That's where the edge materializes.

## The Bottom Line

Sep 21 gave us 66.7% accuracy on a small sample. Sep 22 brings a marginal edge in Tampa Bay. I'm not here to sell you certainty - I'm here to show you where the numbers lean. Stay disciplined, trust the process, and let the law of large numbers work in your favor.
